Digital delivery by email
Redeemable on all ITL products online
No expiration date
Valid for one or multiple purchases until the full balance is used

title: ITL Leather Monarch Duffle
body_html:
The Monarch Duffel is built for the golfer who travels with intention. Handcrafted from full-grain aniline leather, it features a dedicated shoe compartment, trolley strap, and thoughtful interior storage designed to keep everything in its place. Finished with ITL detailing throughout, including custom hardware and subtle nods to the game, it’s a bag that feels at home in the locker room, the airport, and the back seat headed to your next tee time. Available for custom branding for clubs, events, and premium gifting.

Exterior Materials & Detailing
• Full grain semi-aniline leather exterior, offering a rich, natural finish that evolves with wear
• Signature metal ITL-branded pull zippers for durability and elevated branding
• Iconic metal Tee zipper pull, a subtle nod to the game
• Exterior quick-access pocket with ITL metal zipper for everyday essentials

Performance-Driven Storage
• Dedicated exterior shoe compartment with protective interior lining to separate footwear from main storage
• Clean integration ensures structure is maintained whether the compartment is in use or not

Interior Construction
• Durable nylon-lined interior designed to withstand travel demands
• Refined leather accents throughout for a consistent luxury finish
• Interior zipper pocket to securely store valuables

Adaptive Functionality
• Internal leather buttoned strap to secure and flatten the shoe compartment when not in use, preserving usable space

Carry System
• ITL-logo’d ballistic nylon shoulder strap for strength and longevity
• Finished with leather trim and a leather shoulder piece for comfort and style
• Each colourway of the Monarch Duffel comes complete with two custom straps: 
     • Cognac Duffel - Sunrise Strap/Tassel and Midnight Navy Strap/Tassel
     • Chocolate Duffel - Olive Strap/Tassel and Sunrise Strap/Tassel
     • Black Duffel - Citrus Strap/Tassel and Black Strap/Tassel

The 2.0 Signature Glove is the glove for golfers who crave performance that feels effortless.
